questionnaire_2026.Why I'm standing: As a medical doctor I am concerned about the serious decline in quality and delivery of New Zealand's once-excellent health system. Additionally, we need to address diet and exercise with a mind towards prevention. When in Parliament I intend to work hard to focus government attention on our medical and health crisis.
questionnaire_2026.About me: Thirty years in New Zealand has sharpened my sense of its unique position and ability to shape world opinion. I am a fighter and will give my all to turn our country back on the right path of serving its people and not global controlling interests.
